details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The narrative progresses from revenue performance to profitability deterioration, then explains causes (factory shutdown, energy costs), and finally covers balance sheet changes, employment, cash flow, and future outlook. The relationships between causes and effects are clearly articulated (e.g., energy cost surge -> higher COGS -> gross loss). There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization flows logically from performance review to explanations to forward guidance. While the summary covers multiple topics (core operations + real estate project), they are presented as distinct but non-conflicting elements of the overall business.
